role: Full Stack Independent Application Development – Training Cum Internship
jd:
Full Stack Independent Application Development – Training Cum Internship
Location: United States
Job Type: Full-Time / Internship
Work Arrangement: Remote / Hybrid
Experience Level: Entry-Level / InternshipProgram Overview
We are seeking motivated and technically curious individuals for a Full Stack Independent Application Development Training Cum Internship program. This opportunity is designed for candidates who want to strengthen their full stack development skills through structured training, hands-on application development, and practical project experience.
Participants will work on real-world development projects while learning how to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full stack applications. The program provides exposure to both frontend and backend technologies and encourages independent problem-solving and project ownership.Key Responsibilities

- Participate in structured full stack development training and technical learning sessions.
- Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications.
- Build frontend interfaces using modern web technologies.
- Develop backend services, APIs, and application logic.
- Work with databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data.
- Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services.
- Participate in application design, development, testing, and deployment.
- Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
- Debug application issues and troubleshoot technical problems.
- Perform functional and basic performance testing.
- Use Git and version-control practices for application development.
- Collaborate with mentors, developers, designers, and other team members.
- Independently research solutions to technical challenges.
- Document application features, development processes, and technical decisions.
- Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
- Contribute to improving application performance, security, and usability.
- Complete assigned development projects within agreed timelines.Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, diploma, or current enrollment in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
- Basic understanding of software development concepts.
- Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Basic knowledge of frontend or backend development.
- Familiarity with at least one programming language such as JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, PHP, or similar.
- Basic understanding of databases and SQL.
- Familiarity with Git or another version-control system is a plus.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Willingness to learn new technologies and development frameworks.
- Ability to work independently as well as within a team.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.Preferred Skills

- Experience with React, Angular, Vue.js, or another frontend framework.
- Familiarity with Node.js, .NET, Django, Spring Boot, Laravel, or similar backend technologies.
- Knowledge of REST APIs.
- Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar databases.
- Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Experience with responsive web design.
- Personal, academic, freelance, or open-source development projects.
fit_why: Full-stack web dev internship; matches React, Node, PostgreSQL, Git, REST

About Us

A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in.

Job Description:

Job Title: AI Intern, Supply Chain

Rail Pass Type: Internship/Co-op (Full-time/Hybrid)

Departure and Arrival Date (Start -End): January 2027 - December 2027 (12 months)

Vacancy: 1

Toronto Location: 100 Consilium Place, Scarborough, ON M1H 3E3

Work hours/week: 40

Pay Details: $23-$30 CAD hourly

Stations on Your Journey:     

Welcome and Onboarding Station 




- Intern Orientation
- Online Onboarding Curriculum
- Buddy Program for mentorship and guidance


Hands-On Work Station 




- Real-world projects with top industry talent
- Paid internship + paid vacation
- Hybrid work model
- A chance to build your career with a global leader driving digital transformation and innovation that helps support sustainable future


Networking Station     




- "Ask Me Anything" with the Executive Committee
- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
- Social Intern Events: Coffee Breaks, Onsite/Offsite events
- Business Intern Events: Intern Showcase & Graduation ceremony
- Company Social Events: Holiday Party, Employee BBQs, Golf tournament, etc.


Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and tech-savvy co-op student to join our Supply Chain team for a 1-year term. This role is ideal for a student with a passion for automation, data, and artificial intelligence who wants to make a tangible impact on how supply chain processes are executed and optimized.

The successful candidate will support the development, customization, and deployment of AI-driven tools and automation solutions that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value of supply chain operations.

The successful candidate will gain:




- Hands-on experience applying AI and automation in a real-world business context.
- Exposure to supply chain operations and enterprise systems.
- Opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital transformation initiatives.
- Mentorship from experienced professionals in supply chain and technology.


Key Areas of Responsibility




- Collaborate with Supply Chain, and IT teams to identify automation opportunities within supply chain workflows.
- Assist in the design, development, and deployment of AI tools (e.g., chatbots, document analyzers, predictive models) tailored to supply chain needs.
- Customize existing AI solutions to align with internal processes and compliance requirements.
- Support integration of AI tools with supply chain platforms (e.g., ERP systems, internal management tools, price lists).
- Conduct testing, validation, and performance monitoring of deployed solutions.
- Document processes, user guides, and training materials for internal stakeholders.
- Stay current with emerging technologies in AI, machine learning, and supply chain automation.


Required Skills And Experience




- Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Technology Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
- Strong interest in procurement, supply chain, and business operations.
- Hands-on experience with Python.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency with standard computer applications and the ability to learn new systems and concepts quickly.
- Ability to work both independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively within a cross-functional team.
- Ability to apply technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and sound judgment to support supply chain systems and processes.


Preferred Qualifications




- Co-op student available for a 12-month term, with at least one additional academic term remaining after completion of the internship.
- Previous co-op or internship experience is an asset.
- Power Automate or other automation tools is an asset.
- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., OpenAI, Azure AI, TensorFlow) is a plus.
- Scientific background or additional business education or experience considered a plus.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

 Department Overview
 The Storage and Memory Systems (SMS) Pathfinding team explores future memory and storage technologies that enable next-generation AI, high-performance computing, and data-centric systems. By studying emerging AI workloads, system architectures, and memory technologies, the team helps define innovations that shape the future of computing platforms and memory solutions.

 Position Overview
 As an intern in the Storage and Memory Systems (SMS) Pathfinding team, you will research emerging AI workloads, evaluate future memory and storage architectures, and analyze how evolving system requirements impact next-generation technologies. You will collaborate with architects, researchers, and engineers to model, benchmark, and assess innovative concepts that influence Micron's long-term memory and storage roadmap.

 Responsibilities
 
• Research emerging AI models, workloads, and computing architectures to understand future memory and storage requirements. 
• Analyze tradeoffs between performance, power, cost, bandwidth, capacity, latency, and scalability across AI systems. 
• Develop models, simulations, benchmarks, and analytical tools to evaluate next-generation memory and storage concepts. 
• Characterize AI workloads running on CPUs, GPUs, accelerators, and memory-centric computing platforms. 
• Collaborate with architects and engineers to assess new technologies, communicate findings, and support proof-of-concept evaluations. 
 Minimum Qualifications
 
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research projects, academic coursework, or technical projects in computer architecture, AI/ML, high-performance computing, or memory systems. 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 
• Strong understanding of computer architecture, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or high-performance computing concepts. 
• Experience with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or similar technologies. 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 
• Knowledge of memory systems, caching, memory hierarchies, DRAM technologies, and system performance bottlenecks. 
• Experience with performance analysis, benchmarking, profiling, simulation, or system modeling methodologies. 
• Familiarity with GPU computing, accelerators, heterogeneous computing systems, or AI infrastructure. 
• Understanding of AI model architectures, training workflows, inference systems, and workload characterization techniques. 
• Experience applying AI-enabled tools and technologies to research, software development, data analysis, or engineering productivity workflows. 
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits .
